headline: Argentina Country Risk Hits Post-2025 Election High as Dollar Rises
summary: Argentina's dollar bonds fell 1.2% on average, pushing the JP Morgan risk indicator above 830 points for the first time since October 2025, while the dollar rose to $1,570.
why: Sovereign risk spreads and foreign exchange rates reflect investor confidence in Argentina's macroeconomic stabilization program and sovereign debt sustainability.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Dollar bonds fell and country risk rose above 830 points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A drop in dollar bonds and rising country risk metrics increased financial pressure on Argentine sovereign debt.
